mentions.name: ThreadShelf
mentions.description: This tool archives LLM chat conversations from services like OpenRouter, Google AI Studio, and LM Studio into a local archive with semantic search and MCP support, and can continue those conversations through llama.cpp or OpenRouter.
mentions.problem: Chats were scattered across OpenRouter, Google AI Studio, and LM Studio with no good way to view, search, or combine them together.
mentions.source_excerpt: I had a lot of chats in OpenRouter, google AI Studio and lm studio and no good way to view/search/combine them together. ThreadShelf started as a local archive with semantic search/MCP, and later grew support for continuing conversations through llama.cpp or OpenRouter.

evidence.value: I had a lot of chats in OpenRouter, google AI Studio and lm studio and no good way to view/search/combine them together. ThreadShelf started as a local archive with semantic search/MCP, and later grew support for continuing conversations through llama.cpp or OpenRouter.
